title: Polynomial-Time Computability of Repeated Projection
statement: Define $g(z)=\pi_2(\pi_2(z))$, where $\pi_2$ is the total second projection of the aligned pair parser, returning the empty string when parsing fails. Then $g$ is polynomial-time computable.
